idea-plugin.name: Custom Splash Screen
idea-plugin.description:
Replace your JetBrains IDE's startup splash screen with an image you choose. Pick a bundled image or use your own photo, artwork, or logo.

Works across the JetBrains IDE family, including IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, Rider, WebStorm, PhpStorm, GoLand, CLion, and more.

Open Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Custom Splash Screen, enable Use a custom splash image, and choose an image. Click Apply and restart your IDE. Supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, and BMP files up to 20 MiB and 16 megapixels.

No upper IDE-version restriction. After an IDE update, cache reset, or display-scale change, the default splash may appear once before your image is reapplied.
